description.to:
Outcome: Port the story card and the reference card from Machines on Machines' web/mom_components.py into core as one Python implementation taking data, not HTML, with golden renders for two brand packs. No MoM file changes. Thread and wiki cards are a later slice. Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) core-cards-slice-1, branch feature/<this issue id>-core-cards-slice-1 from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-core-cards-slice-1, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/ (new cards module), golden render fixtures, MoM repository read-only.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/core-cards.feature):
Scenario: A story card renders from data in two brands
    Given a story's data and two brand packs
    When the card renders
    Then the HTML matches the accepted golden render for each brand

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-613a29.

Testing: poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/projection/standard; poetry run behave features_backend/core-cards.feature.
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
